summary: Frontend-only check of the 'Doar novamente' navigation on /doacao/pix. 1) The DOAR NOVAMENTE button (data-testid=donate-again-button) on the PIX page goes to '/' and the home AACD iframe (home-aacd-frame) shows, on desktop 1920x1080 and on mobile 390x844. 2) The success-page 'Doar novamente' link (donate-again-link), reached by copying the PIX code and moving Date.now forward by 400s, also goes to '/' with the iframe visible. The iteration_1 issue (link going to '/doacao' -> /instituicao/humus) is fixed: both now call navigate('/'). No leftover navigate('/doacao') references in src.

issues: The success image (menina-comemorando.png) area was blank in the screenshot. The asset URL returns 200 image/png (152KB), so it was probably still loading when the screenshot ran. Minor, not a confirmed defect.

critical_code_review_comments: PixPaymentPage falls back to value 50 when location.state is missing, while the home page minimum is R$55. Opening /doacao/pix directly therefore creates a R$50 donation record. Consider redirecting to '/' when there is no state.
seed_data_creation: Each /doacao/pix load registers a donation (R$50, anonymous, no state), so about 3 anonymous R$50 donation records were created by this test, one of them marked copied=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the success page: click copy-pix-code-button, then page.evaluate to override Date.now with a +400000ms offset; success-page then shows within about 1s. Home is iframe[data-testid=home-aacd-frame].
